The GOSH Regional Events Funding Program is for groups that want to host an event, workshop, conference, or get-together to support open science hardware.

Throughout 2021 and 2022, we funded regional events that took place in Africa, Latin America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America.

The main eligibility criteria are that the event must be aligned with the [GOSH Manifesto](https://openhardware.science/gosh-manifesto/) to make open source science hardware ubiquitous and with the GOSH Community’s ethos of inclusiveness.

Image Credit: [Gathering for Open Science Hardware](https://www.flickr.com/photos/goshcommunity/43754536270/in/album-72157674579730208/)
